remarks: This absolutely stunning Colonial, perfectly perched on a beautiful tree-lined street in the Town of Lockport, is truly picture-perfect inside & out. Thoughtfully updated & meticulously maintained, this 2600 sq ft home offers everything you need for comfortable everyday living & effortless entertaining. Step inside to spotless HW flooring, beautiful six-panel hardwood doors, custom windows complemented by custom blinds & window treatments, and well-defined living spaces that create an elegant yet inviting atmosphere. The spacious living room is highlighted by a beautiful gas fireplace, adding warmth & character to the home. An elegant formal dining room provides the perfect setting for entertaining family & friends throughout the holidays and beyond. The updated eat-in kitchen features beautiful cabinetry, granite countertops, abundant workspace & storage, & flows seamlessly into the inviting 3-season sunroom, boasting another gorgeous gas fireplace, vaulted ceiling and skylight. Surrounded by windows overlooking the backyard, this is the perfect space to relax, unwind & enjoy the view. Built-in speakers throughout the first floor allow you to enjoy your favorite music while entertaining or simply relaxing at home. A spacious first-floor office and convenient first-floor laundry complete this beautifully designed level. Upstairs you’ll find 4 generously sized bdrms & 2 full baths, including a beautifully updated primary bath completed in 2025. The additional full bath is equally well appointed w/ attractive granite countertops. Step outside or simply take in the view from the sunroom to your own private backyard oasis. Stunning established landscaping & beautiful perennials create a gorgeous setting year after year, while the in-ground pool & covered stamped-concrete patio provide the perfect backdrop for summer entertaining, relaxing & enjoying the outdoors. The spacious 2.5-car garage offers excellent storage along w/ a separate additional area ideal for lawn equipment, tools, seasonal items and all the extras, keeping the main garage space organized & functional. Additional highlights include newer HVAC and a roof approx. 10 years young. Just unpack & relax.
